# Design System Ops

> A skill pack for Claude that audits, governs, documents, validates, and communicates design systems. Skills are markdown instructions; each one loads shared knowledge notes that carry the frameworks behind its findings.

The pack only works with its folders side by side. Every skill under `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` lists the knowledge notes it depends on in its frontmatter `references:` field, as paths like `../../knowledge-notes/token-architecture.md`. If `knowledge-notes/` is not next to `skills/`, the install is broken: installers that flatten each skill into its own folder (for example `npx skills install`) cause this. Install with git clone or the `.plugin` bundle instead, then run `verify-install.sh` from the install root to confirm every reference resolves.

## Start here

- [README.md](README.md): what the pack does, installation, and example prompts
- [1-INSTALL.md](1-INSTALL.md): supported install methods, how to verify an install, and which skill to start with
- [2-WHATS-INCLUDED.md](2-WHATS-INCLUDED.md): every skill, agent, and knowledge note, with what each one is for

## Reference

- [knowledge-notes/](knowledge-notes/): the shared frameworks skills load before they run
- [knowledge-notes/output-discipline.md](knowledge-notes/output-discipline.md): how every audit scopes its claims and reports findings
- [commands/](commands/): slash commands, including the chained agent workflows
- [ds-ops-config.example.yml](ds-ops-config.example.yml): the annotated configuration template
